id: \bI suppose you need to move on now. Don't let me stop you.
en: \bI suppose you need to move on now. Don't let me stop you.
it: \bImmagino che ora tu debba proseguire. Non lasciare che sia io a fermarti.

id: \bI don't want this anymore. Take it away for me.
en: \bI don't want this anymore. Take it away for me.
it: \bNon lo voglio più. Portalo via tu per me.

id: \bI don't care what you do with.
en: \bI don't care what you do with.

id: \rSorry. It's just most people take the road.
en: \rSorry. It's just most people take the road.
it: \rScusa. È che di solito la gente prende la strada.

id: \rUndella Town is up ahead. The place is so pretty.
en: \rUndella Town is up ahead. The place is so pretty.
it: \rPiù avanti c'è Spiraria. È un posto bellissimo.

id: \bI'm still not giving you a ride.
en: \bI'm still not giving you a ride.

id: \bI see you took the easy path.
en: \bI see you took the easy path.
it: \bVedo che hai preso la strada facile.

id: \bTall grass makes people skirt it. I see you're like everyone else.
en: \bTall grass makes people skirt it. I see you're like everyone else.
it: \bL'erba alta spinge la gente a girarle intorno. Vedo che sei come tutti gli altri.

id: \bI see you took the hard path.
en: \bI see you took the hard path.
it: \bVedo che hai preso la strada difficile.

id: \bTall grass makes people skirt it. I'm glad there are some that don't.
en: \bTall grass makes people skirt it. I'm glad there are some that don't.
it: \bL'erba alta spinge la gente a girarle intorno. Sono contento che qualcuno non lo faccia.
